confidence_notes: Two web searches were run. The first was for the RBA rate. The second was for Brasov prices, and it returned crowd-sourced Mylifeelsewhere figures for beer, cappuccino and an inexpensive meal. The search results gave a 2026-11-18 RBA rate of 0.6720, and a provisional 2026-11-19 value that I did not use. I did not search for mid-range meal, cocktail or wine prices. The mid-range meal is a model estimate scaled from the inexpensive-meal price. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price, at roughly 2.5x and 2x. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from any listings, and they are the least certain. They also vary a lot by season, since July is high season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other tourist-oriented mid-sized Romanian cities such as Sibiu and Cluj-Napoca. Brasov is somewhat pricier than Romania's average because of mountain-resort tourism.
